about: Gates that all hold whatever they are asked about: every check that must refuse fails.

mutations.find: export const gatesOf = (c) => PROMOTION_GATES.map((g) => ({ id: g.id, holds: g.holds(c) === true, onFail: g.onFail, say: String(g.say(c)).slice(0, 240) }));
mutations.replace: export const gatesOf = () => PROMOTION_GATES.map((g) => ({ id: g.id, holds: true, onFail: g.onFail, say: "it holds" }));
